config.ysm_epicfight_compat.client.toolt: Client-side YSM and Epic Fight compatibility settings.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.client_model: Maximum number of converted YSM combat meshes retained in memory.
Maximum disk space for parsed models available on this client. Zero disables and clears this cache.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.remote_model: Maximum disk space for models received from multiplayer servers. Zero disables and clears this cache.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.server_model: Persists generated server model transfer payloads between sessions. The memory cache remains active when disabled.
Maximum disk space for generated server model payloads. Zero disables and clears this cache.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.suppress_bat: Hide YSM overlay in battle mode
Hides official YSM's top-left player overlay while Epic Fight battle mode is active.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.use_ysm_held: When enabled, uses model-authored YSM weapons and tools when available. Only the resolved display state, not this setting, is synchronized to other players.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.held_item_mo: Each model ID has item IDs or #item_tags that disable YSM held-item models even while the main setting is enabled. The list has no effect while the main setting is disabled. Configured automatically adds the currently selected model. These rules stay local; only their resolved display state is synchronized.
Item IDs or #item_tags that disable YSM held-item models for this YSM model.
Enter an item ID such as minecraft:diamond_sword or an item tag such as #forge:tools/bows.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.use_ysm_proj: When enabled, uses model-authored YSM projectile geometry when no corresponding YSM held-item model controls the projectile. Only the resolved display state, not this setting, is synchronized to other players.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.projectile_m: Each model ID has entity IDs or #entity_type_tags that disable YSM projectile models even while the main setting is enabled. The list has no effect while the main setting is disabled. Configured automatically adds the currently selected model. These rules stay local; only their resolved display state is synchronized.
Entity IDs or #entity_type_tags that disable YSM projectile models for this YSM model.
Enter an entity ID such as minecraft:arrow or an entity-type tag such as #minecraft:arrows.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.use_ysm_vehi: When enabled, uses model-authored YSM vehicle geometry when available. Hiding it leaves vehicle-riding animation ownership with Epic Fight. Only the resolved display state, not this setting, is synchronized to other players.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.vehicle_mode: Each model ID has entity IDs or #entity_type_tags that disable YSM vehicle models even while the main setting is enabled. The list has no effect while the main setting is disabled. Configured automatically adds the currently selected model. These rules stay local; only their resolved display state is synchronized.
Entity IDs or #entity_type_tags that disable YSM vehicle models for this YSM model.
Enter an entity ID such as minecraft:boat or an entity-type tag such as #minecraft:boats.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.use_ysm_held: When enabled, uses the official YSM draw/switch pose while Epic Fight keeps rendering the ordinary item. Model-authored replacement items instead follow the YSM held-item model setting. Only the resolved animation state is synchronized.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.held_item_sw: Each model ID has item IDs or #item_tags that disable YSM item-switch animations even while the main setting is enabled. The list has no effect while the main setting is disabled. Use minecraft:air for switching to an empty hand. Configured automatically adds the currently selected model. These rules stay local; only their resolved animation state is synchronized.
Item IDs or #item_tags that disable YSM item-switch animations for this YSM model. minecraft:air represents an empty hand.
Enter an item ID such as minecraft:diamond_pickaxe or minecraft:air, or an item tag such as #forge:tools/pickaxes.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.use_ysm_move: When enabled, lets model-authored YSM full-body locomotion replace Epic Fight locomotion. The current resolved pose decision, not these rules, is synchronized to other players.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.use_natural_: When enabled, keeps authored YSM arm motion on both arms so both hands can climb. Ordinary Epic Fight items are stowed; items replaced by a YSM model are hidden. Models without dedicated ladder arm motion keep their original behavior. Only the resolved pose state, not this setting, is synchronized.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.movement_ani: Each model ID has movement states that disable YSM movement animation even while the main setting is enabled. The list has no effect while the main setting is disabled. Configured automatically adds the currently selected model. Rules stay local; only the current resolved pose decision is synchronized.
Movement states that disable YSM movement animation for this YSM model.
Use: walk, run, sneak_idle, sneak_move, jump, creative_flight, elytra_flight, swim, water_idle, crawl_idle, crawl_move, ladder_idle, ladder_up, or ladder_down.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.use_ysm_parc: Prioritizes YSM ParCool action animations in Epic Fight battle mode, except model-specific ParCool exclusions. When Epic ParCool is loaded, its Chain movement and Wall movement animations keep the addon pose regardless of this setting or its exclusions. Actual attacks, guarding, and hit reactions retain Epic Fight's pose. Independent of SWEM and ordinary movement settings. Only the active animation family, clip name, and resolved pose decision are synchronized; settings and exclusion lists stay local.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.parcool_anim: Each model ID has short ParCool action names that disable YSM animation while the ParCool setting is enabled. Empty by default; the list never enables animations when the setting is disabled. Independent of SWEM and ordinary movement exclusions. Configured automatically adds the currently selected model. Epic ParCool's Chain movement and Wall movement always keep the addon pose when loaded. Rules stay local; only the active animation family, clip name, and resolved pose decision are synchronized.
Short ParCool action names that disable YSM animations for this model. Use names without the parcool: prefix. Wildcards such as * and names from other animation families are not supported.

Use one of: backward_wall_jump, cat_leap, climb_up, cling_to_cliff, cling_to_cliff_left, cling_to_cliff_right, dive_animation_host, dive_into_water, dodge_front, dodge_back, dodge_left, dodge_right, fast_running, fast_swim, flipping_front, flipping_back, horizontal_wall_run_right, horizontal_wall_run_left, vertical_wall_run, jump_from_bar, hang, hang_vertical, kong_vault, speed_vault_left, speed_vault_right, roll_front, roll_back, roll_left, roll_right, sliding, tap, wall_jump_left, wall_jump_right, wall_slide_left, wall_slide_right, jump_charging, charge_jump, ride_zipline.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.use_ysm_swem: Prioritizes YSM SWEM riding animations in Epic Fight battle mode, except model-specific SWEM exclusions. Actual attacks, guarding, and hit reactions retain Epic Fight's pose. Independent of ParCool and ordinary movement settings. Only the active animation family, clip name, and resolved pose decision are synchronized; settings and exclusion lists stay local.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.swem_animati: Each model ID has short SWEM riding-animation names that disable YSM animation while the SWEM setting is enabled. Empty by default; the list never enables animations when the setting is disabled. Independent of ParCool and ordinary movement exclusions. Configured automatically adds the currently selected model. Rules stay local; only the active animation family, clip name, and resolved pose decision are synchronized.
Short SWEM riding-animation names that disable YSM animations for this model. Use names without the swem: prefix. Wildcards such as * and names from other animation families are not supported.
Use one of: idle, walk, trot, canter, canter_ext, gallop, jump_lv1, jump_lv2, jump_lv3, jump_lv4, jump_lv5.
config.ysm_epicfight_compat.warning_ackn: Whether the official YSM and Epic Fight compatibility warning has already been shown.
